hypothesis: For a14 rows lacking the incumbent K562/PerturbMatch route or having fewer than three real-donor carriers, a leave-target-out neighbor direction built from the exact DepMap 24Q4 co-essentiality representation, especially its published-weight 1.0 blend with STRING, improves target retrieval and downstream sign precision without changing any other row.

eligibility.incumbent_uncovered_definition: The exact a14 PerturbMatch audit category neither_supported_preserved: neither K562-GWPS nor PerturbMatch carries the target, so the K562 slot is absent and preserved unchanged.
eligibility.low_confidence_definition: A target carried by fewer than all three frozen real donors, excluding rows already in incumbent_uncovered_targets. No held outcome, target embedding, effect norm, or leaderboard value enters this rule.

depmap_24q4.column_label_parser: split once on literal ' (' and retain the symbol prefix
transform: replace every nonfinite source value with NaN
replace NaN centered entries with exact float32 zero
L2 normalize each gene row in float32 with zero norms replaced by one
drop rows with fewer than two finite values; retain zero centered-norm rows as zero feature vectors

blend.missing_block_policy: zero block; do not drop a gene covered by the other representation

candidate_construction.source_effect_input: role-owned donor-level source-only rows from ROLE_SOURCE_MANIFEST.json on the canonical gene axis
candidate_construction.source_bank_target_universe: union of the exact positive top-25 leave-query-target-out neighbours for every one of the 41 eligible queries across STRING, DepMap, and the weight-1 blend
candidate_construction.source_bank_effect_space: a14 donor deviations after role normalization and role-specific whitening at gamma 0.65 lambda 0, with no bank-global median renormalization because final candidates are restored to incumbent row norm
candidate_construction.source_bank_excluded_response_coordinate: union of all 300 VCC panel targets and the role held-surface target axis
candidate_construction.source_consensus: equal donor weight per target and per-coordinate mean over rows that cover that coordinate
candidate_construction.leave_target_out: For each query target, remove every source signature with the same target symbol before neighbor selection and aggregation.
candidate_construction.response_coordinate_mask: Remove all 300 VCC target-gene coordinates from source effects, incumbent rows, candidate rows, normalization, PDS, and directional precision.
candidate_construction.neighbour_tie_policy: exactly 25 positive neighbours maximum; descending similarity with ties resolved by frozen sorted source-target order
candidate_construction.aggregation: coverage-aware weighted mean per response coordinate
candidate_construction.row_scale: restore the incumbent row L2 norm on allowed response coordinates
candidate_construction.confidence: absolute value of the final stored effect array after dtype conversion
candidate_construction.unsupported_policy: If the query feature is unavailable, no positive neighbor survives, the candidate row is nonfinite or zero norm, or the incumbent row has zero allowed-coordinate norm, return the incumbent row bit-for-bit.

arms.identity: Exact incumbent matrix; mandatory bit-identity control.
arms.current_fallback: Exact incumbent matrix under a separate named comparator; it must be array-identical to identity.
arms.string_neighbor: Eligible rows use the frozen STRING representation and candidate construction; every other or unsupported row is exact incumbent.
arms.depmap_neighbor: Eligible rows use the exact DepMap 24Q4 representation and candidate construction; every other or unsupported row is exact incumbent.
arms.string_depmap_blend_w1: Eligible rows use the frozen 1.0 STRING plus DepMap concatenated representation and candidate construction; every other or unsupported row is exact incumbent.

evaluation.held_access_order: All real arms, permutation-null arms, source-blind confidence arrays, target lists, gene masks, implementation hashes, and input hashes must be frozen before any held perturbation truth path is accepted or opened.
evaluation.clean_surface_policy: Every surface marked clean=true in the separately reviewed evaluation manifest is mandatory. A depth-confounded surface may not contribute directional precision.

directional_precision.selection: For each arm and target, rank allowed response genes by absolute frozen predicted effect, before truth access.
directional_precision.truth: reference directional sign; reference-nonsignificant or zero-sign genes count as incorrect when selected
directional_precision.aggregation: equal weight per target, then equal weight per clean surface

target_label_permutation_nulls.operation: Permute query-target feature labels within stratum while keeping source effects, source labels, incumbent rows, support masks, arm parameters, and target ordering fixed.
